facts: The Royal Tasmanian Botanical Gardens are at Lower Domain Road, Queens Domain, Hobart; the site provides a map and living-collection database. Location: footer, Site Map and Flora Map.

The site carries the notice “Conservatory is currently closed for restoration”. This was present on the research date; visitors should recheck current projects before arrival. Location: opening alert.
notes: Read the captured official/operator/community source. Facts and quoted locations above were checked for both language versions. Prices and detailed timetables are omitted; dated access notices are explicitly dated and require rechecking. HTML retained during research in /tmp/hobart-gardens.html.
title: Botanical Gardens of Tasmania — Official visitor website
